reddit.title: Nice City: get out of work on GTA 6 launch day, outrun HR and the cops, get home and play first (free, 3 min, browser)
reddit.comment: I made this. It's a short parody about the hardest mission of launch week: getting the day off. Fake a cough or quit, outrun HR, the cops or the loan sharks across a 90s-style city, cut the line at the store, sneak past your fiancée, then guess the password. Plays on any phone, no signup. Which way past the boss did you pick, sick or quit?
